Preconditions: Admin signed in at {{BACK_URL}} with notification management permissions; a notification type whose Templates grid ALREADY carries a row badged both 'Predefined' and 'Edited' - i.e. a saved override of a shipped default exists for that language. The case must start from an existing override, never create one, so that its cleanup can restore prior content by re-saving instead of taking the destructive reset path (that path is NOTIF-075, on a disposable override). 'InvoiceEmailNotification' carries such a row in the reference environment; module version is the PR #202 build or later. Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] the save issues PUT /api/notifications/{type} and returns 2xx (VCST-5607: the drill-down path issues no PUT today)
[NETWORK] clicking 'Restore' and then 'Cancel' issues no mutating request at all

[WAIT] the '...: Template' blade opens on the predefined template from the cold load

[WAIT] the save settles, creating a disposable override
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/#!/workspace/notifications

[ACT] click the matching notification row

[WAIT] the '...: Template' blade opens
[ACT] click 'Restore' in the blade toolbar
